name: Ranger Campsite places its bedrolls, and resting on one grants Well Rested
contract: Ranger Campsite 807955 places three objects with SPELL_EFFECT_TRANS_DOOR: Bright Campfire 31511 and the Ranger's Campsite bedrolls 1005767 and 1005768. Captured client gameobject caches give both bedrolls type 22 (GAMEOBJECT_TYPE_SPELLCASTER) with Data0 583404 'Resting'; without a gameobject_template row Spell::EffectTransmitted skips them and only the campfire appears. Using a bedroll casts 583404 on the user: a 60 s aura (DurationIndex 3) whose periodic effect (SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL, amplitude 59999 ms) triggers 997616 'Well Rested'. A Ranger who rests out the full minute on the bedroll carries Well Rested.
